name: OBC Conservation Fund small grants
summary: Small grants for bird conservation projects in the Oriental region, prioritising threatened species, important bird areas and on-the-ground action involving local communities. Priority goes to NGOs or individuals from the project country. New projects in China are not being funded for now.

calls.label: Small grants, 1 March and 1 September deadlines
calls.recurring: Deadlines 1 March and 1 September each year

status.quote: Small grants are offered twice a year with deadlines for applications being 1st March and 1st September.

recurring.quote: Small grants are offered twice a year with deadlines for applications being 1st March and 1st September.

applicant_types.quote: NGOs or individuals from the country where the project takes place.

geography.quote: The Oriental Bird Club supports conservation work in the Oriental region by funding projects which encourage an interest in wild birds and their conservation

access.quote: To apply for funding complete the grant application form and send it to conservation@orientalbirdclub.org

window.quote: Small grants are offered twice a year with deadlines for applications being 1st March and 1st September.

amount.quote: OBC small grants are typically between £1,000 and £2,000. In exceptional cases, we will fund projects up to £3,000.
